training.note: All-tracks curriculum run (configs/classic_all_tracks_32ray_accel.json, run sensor32_accel_all_tracks_20260901, warm-started from the single-track 32ray+accel smoke policy) over the full Easy/Medium/Pro curriculum, using best-checkpoint tracking (periodic deterministic evaluation, keep the best-scoring network rather than whatever's last). Manually stopped at 2,745.6s active (control-stop) rather than the full 3,600s target; the run's own final checkpoint had regressed to 3.3% finish rate by the stop point, confirming the same late-training collapse tendency seen in earlier runs. This bundled policy is that run's best checkpoint, unaffected by the later regression. See docs/training-runs.md.

reference_evaluation.note: One episode per curriculum environment (all 30 Easy/Medium/Pro tracks), deterministic, seed 2000007. Solves 7/30 tracks. Captured mid-run; see docs/training-runs.md for the run's final result.
